WITH filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT s.questregistry, s.zoneref, s.gbsize, s.spanmin
  FROM scans s
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND s.zoneref IS NOT NULL
),
scans_with_site AS (
  SELECT fs.questregistry, fs.zoneref, fs.gbsize, fs.spanmin, z.healtheval
  FROM filtered_scans fs
  INNER JOIN sites z ON fs.zoneref = z.zoneregistry
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    zoneref,
    healtheval,
    AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0
             THEN gbsize / spanmin
             ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM scans_with_site
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_value
  FROM group_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  gs.zoneref,
  gs.healtheval,
  gs.avg_ratio,
  gs.scan_count,
  gs.avg_ratio - om.mean_value as beat_amount
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_value IS NOT NULL
  AND gs.avg_ratio > om.mean_value
ORDER BY beat_amount DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
